name: straight_set
description: Standard sets and reps with fixed rest between each.
typical_use: Default for compound lifts and strength work.

name: superset
description: Two exercises back-to-back with no rest; rest only after both done.
typical_use: Paired antagonists or accessories to save time and drive volume.

name: giant_set
description: Three or more exercises performed back-to-back with no rest.
typical_use: Hypertrophy finisher for a muscle group; high time-efficiency.

name: fst7
description: Seven sets of one exercise at the end of a muscle group with ~30s rest; targets fascia.
typical_use: Final exercise on a bodypart to chase a pump (Gethin staple).

name: drop_set
description: Take a set to failure then reduce weight and continue to failure.

name: triple_drop_set
description: Three continuous drops from heavier to lighter weight in one extended set.

name: rest_pause
description: Set to failure; rest 10-20s; continue; optionally repeat.
typical_use: Hit more reps beyond initial failure with the same weight.

name: cardio_acceleration
description: 1 minute of high-intensity cardio/conditioning replaces rest between lifting sets.
typical_use: S2S hallmark; layers fat-loss on top of lifting.

name: dtp
description: Dramatic Transformation Principle: pyramid of 50/40/30/20/10/10/20/30/40/50 reps (one exercise) or as a paired superset.
typical_use: High-volume metabolic finisher or whole-workout structure (Gethin late weeks).

name: pyramid
description: Ascending weight + descending reps (e.g. 15->12->10->8->6) or reverse.

name: 21s
description: 7 half-reps bottom + 7 half-reps top + 7 full-range reps in one set.

name: partial_reps
description: Extend a set past failure by performing half-range reps.

name: negative_reps
description: Slow eccentric only; usually with spotter help on the concentric.
typical_use: Overload past concentric failure on final set.

name: one_and_a_half
description: Full rep + half rep = 1.5 reps counted as 1.
typical_use: Quad / shoulder burner; lower weight; high tension.

name: circuit
description: Rotate through N exercises with minimal rest; rest between rounds.
